name: lillatolken-live
description: Personal mobile interpreter that translates classroom speech into Chinese audio.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @lilla/shared && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @lilla/server" "npm run dev -w @lilla/web"
scripts.dev:phone: npm run build -w @lilla/shared && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @lilla/server" "npm run dev:phone -w @lilla/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lilla/shared && npm run build -w @lilla/server && npm run build -w @lilla/web
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @lilla/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @lilla/shared && npm run typecheck -w @lilla/server && npm run typecheck -w @lilla/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @lilla/shared && npm run test -w @lilla/shared && npm run test -w @lilla/server && npm run test -w @lilla/web
